item.description:
A reminder when the focus block never happens.

New

  • After half an hour at your Mac without a focus block, a short offer to start one appears in the top right
  • At most once in the morning and once in the afternoon, only between 6 am and 8 pm, switchable off under Settings › Focus
  • It reads only how many seconds have passed since your last input — not what you are doing; nothing is stored and nothing is sent

Fixed

  • "+1 min" extended the breathing exercise by up to 80 seconds instead of one minute — nearly a doubling at six cycles
  • The button now shows that it was pressed and names the time it credited
